'''Guller''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] that belonged to the [[Blood Nest]] pirate group. During [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller's'']] visit to the [[M2398 system]], he was assigned to the system's [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt as a lookout before the [[Battle of M2398-3|battle]] occurred.<ref name="WS" />
